decision.decision_statement: Which niche should this product target first, and how should it be positioned to win?
decision.success_threshold: Identify a beachhead segment with evidence-backed product-market fit potential and a clear positioning statement
risks: B2C AI job risk calculator space is saturated with 12+ free competitors
Enterprise workforce audit is crowded with 8+ well-funded competitors
Product breadth without focus is a positioning weakness
No first-party customer evidence to validate any hypothesis
conflicts_of_interest: Founder is decision owner — self-interest bias toward positive outcomes
Auditor is AI agent — lacks human market intuition, may miss qualitative signals

No executed experiments — validation confidence is 0
Web research may have recency/availability bias
AI auditor lacks human market intuition

Conversion rate from free to paid
User behavior patterns and feature usage
SEO ranking and organic traffic data
